description: Eerste Helmersstraat 217-229 (1897): 6 m red-brown brick fronts of a ground and two upper storeys under a cream moulded cornice at 10.8 m; three equal axes of tall two-light windows with a transom, shallow segmental brick heads, white stone sills; a bellied wrought-iron balconette on the centre axis of both upper storeys; one white cast vent panel per axis in the frieze; one white timber dormer with a pointed pediment and a finial; double house door with a fanlight on the left axis

pointed-dormer.note: 223-229: one white timber dormer, pointed pediment with a finial, centred Dormer (#81 review 2026-10-25): measured on the strips about 1.1 m wide, a body of 1.1-1.3 m to a white pediment cap of about 0.5 m, standing on the roof behind the cornice cap (the kit's sill and setback, 1.15 m body); a white painted body (dormerBody stone). The finial is not expressed.

door-left.note: double door under a fanlight on the left axis, two windows with a transom

rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: 3 two-light windows with a transom, one width
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; door on the left
rhythm.roofline: cream moulded cornice at 10.8 m over a frieze with three vent panels; one pointed timber dormer

match.note: the 1897 row of Eerste Helmersstraat 217-229: 6 m, cornice 10.8 m by the strip skyline (--photo-eaves); 3DBAG/PDOK eaves read the mansard top (10.9-13.4 m)
